diagnosis.overall_diagnosis: The agent's Q1 answer returned 8 EIDs but the expected answer has 11. The failure is in the key reviewer/author extraction logic — the agent limited reviewers to meeting participants of a single planning meeting instead of aggregating authors + reviewers across all related artifacts (multiple docs, PRs, chats). The enterprise-artifact-search skill explicitly handles 'key reviewer extraction rules' and product grounding, so it is the relevant skill to repair with clearer guidance on exhaustive multi-artifact aggregation for authors+reviewers questions.

diagnosed_skills.diagnosis: The skill's key-reviewer extraction rules caused under-collection: the agent treated only one planning meeting's participants as the reviewer set and merged with a single author, yielding 8 instead of 11 EIDs. The skill needs stronger guidance to (a) enumerate ALL document versions/related artifacts for a given report (drafts, PR reviewers, follow-up meetings, chat threads tagging the doc), (b) union authors across all versions AND reviewers across all review artifacts, (c) deduplicate by EID but never prune contributors who appear in any review-type evidence (explicit 'reviewer' field, PR approvers/reviewers, meeting participants of review meetings, chat commenters providing substantive feedback), and (d) when question asks for 'authors and key reviewers', output the UNION — not the intersection or a single meeting's roster.
diagnosed_skills.repair_instruction: Edit enterprise-artifact-search/SKILL.md to add an explicit 'Authors + Key Reviewers Aggregation Protocol' section. Specify: (1) First locate ALL artifacts of the target document (search by codename AND public name, include drafts/versions/final). (2) Collect authors from every version's author/contributor fields (union). (3) Collect reviewers from: explicit 'reviewers' metadata fields, PR reviewers/approvers linked to the doc, participants of meetings whose subject references the doc, and chat/thread users providing substantive review feedback on the doc. (4) Return the UNION of all EIDs, deduped. (5) Warn: do NOT restrict to a single meeting's participant list — enterprise reports typically have 10+ contributors spread across artifacts. (6) Add a self-check: if the final list has fewer than ~10 EIDs for a 'market research report' style artifact, re-scan for missed PRs, additional review meetings, and chat threads before finalizing.
